name: Paphos
summary: Paphos is a UNESCO town in western Cyprus, full of Roman floor mosaics and royal tombs carved from rock. See the mosaics of the House of Dionysos, explore the Tombs of the Kings, swim at Aphrodite's Rock where the goddess rose from the sea, and drive to the wild Akamas peninsula and the Avakas Gorge.
seasonNote: Swimming from May to November; July and August are very hot.
arrival: Paphos Airport is 20 minutes away; Larnaca is 1h30 by shuttle.
gettingAround: Buses link Kato Paphos and the old town; rent a car for Akamas and the mountains (drive on the left).
cashTip: Cards are widely accepted; tip about 10 percent if service is not included.
foodTip: Halloumi, souvla, kleftiko, meze and Commandaria sweet wine.
buyTip: Halloumi, Lefkara lace and Commandaria wine.
